title: Processes
description: Business processes as diagrams: a description in words and the BPMN diagram.
newDescription: Saved as a draft; it appears under “Tools” once it is published.
emptyHint: Create the first one, for example “Goods receipt”.

summary.label: Description
summary.hint: Describe the steps and the branches in words, in order. This is the text version of the diagram: readers who cannot see the picture rely on it.
summary.required: Please describe the process in words.
summary.tooLong: The description may have at most 2,000 characters.

department.label: Department
department.hint: That department's head and team leads maintain the process too.

diagram.label: Diagram
diagram.invalid: This is not a BPMN 2.0 diagram that can be stored.
diagram.tooLong: The diagram is too large to save (at most 300,000 characters and 700 KiB).

diagram.loadFailed: The diagram could not be opened. You can replace it by importing a file.
diagram.importHint: A BPMN 2.0 file made with another tool. It replaces the diagram below and is stored when you save.
diagram.importTooLarge: This file is larger than 700 KiB and cannot be imported.
diagram.importInvalid: This file is not a BPMN 2.0 diagram that can be stored.
diagram.importFailed: The file could not be read.
diagram.imported: File imported. Save to keep it.
diagram.keyboardNote: Drawing diagrams needs a mouse or touch; import and the text description work by keyboard.
diagram.storedNote: Imported and edited diagrams are stored in the intranet when you save.
